prs.cluster_pick_reason: #1996 adds a dedicated acceptsMediaType() parser that correctly handles the Accept header grammar: splits on commas/semicolons, excludes entries with q=0, and matches type/subtype (including wildcards) per-token. #2046 instead uses acceptHeader.includes('application/json'), a plain substring check that would also match unrelated media types like 'application/json-patch+json' or 'application/jsonlines' and ignores q=0 'not acceptable' markers — a correctness gap #1996 doesn't have.
